name: Export Diagram (COMPAS CEM)
description: Export a COMPAS CEM diagram and save it as a JSON file.

inputParameters.name: export
inputParameters.description: Writes the diagram to the JSON file when True.

inputParameters.name: filepath
inputParameters.description: The full filepath of where to save the diagram as a JSON file. Do not forget to add the extension .json to the filename.

outputParameters.name: data
outputParameters.description: The JSON representation of the diagram, output only on the run that writes the file.
